requirements.summary: Remove the ProfileSetupModal component and all its imports from the application
acceptanceCriteria: ProfileSetupModal component is completely removed from the codebase
No profile completion popup appears anywhere in the application
All references to ProfileSetupModal are removed from parent components

file_operations.description: Delete the ProfileSetupModal component file that displays the profile completion popup for first-time users
Remove the import statement for ProfileSetupModal and remove any JSX rendering of the ProfileSetupModal component from the layout
Remove any import and usage of ProfileSetupModal component if present in the feed page

requirements.summary: Remove any logic that triggers or checks for profile completion status
acceptanceCriteria: No conditional logic exists that would show profile setup dialog
Application flow does not check for incomplete profiles
Users can access all features without being prompted to complete profile

file_operations.description: Remove any state variables, useEffect hooks, or conditional logic that checks whether a user profile exists and triggers the profile setup modal. Ensure the user can navigate the app without profile completion checks
Remove any conditional rendering logic that would show the ProfileSetupModal based on user profile status. Clean up any related state or query dependencies
Review and remove any top-level profile completion checks or modal triggers that might affect application-wide navigation or access
